# Currency Exchange Association

> A community-based financial services provider offering check cashing, currency exchange, cryptocurrency services, and Illinois vehicle registration solutions.

The Currency Exchange Association is an Illinois-based financial services organization providing essential banking alternatives and government services to underbanked communities. They operate as a Western Union agent and offer cryptocurrency services alongside traditional check cashing and currency exchange.

## Key Topics

- Check Cashing
- Currency Exchange
- Bitcoin ATMs
- Western Union
- Prepaid Visa Cards
- Vehicle Registration
- License Plate Renewal
- ATM Services
- Debit Card Services
- Financial Services
- Cash Conversion
- No-Holds Policy
- Extended Hours
- Community Banking
- Illinois Secretary of State

## Core Financial Services

- [Services](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services): Overview of financial services including check cashing, currency exchange, Bitcoin
- [Check Cashing](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/check-cashing): Check cashing service for payroll and multiple check types
- [Business Check Cashing](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/business-check-cashing): Business check cashing with instant cash and no holds
- [Foreign Currency Exchange](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/foreign-currency-exchange): Currency conversion and cash exchange for travel
- [Bitcoin](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/bitcoin): Bitcoin ATM and cryptocurrency exchange services

## Cash & Card Services

- [ATM Service](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/atm-service): ATM cash withdrawal and balance inquiry services
- [Debit Card Unload](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/debit-card-unload): Debit card cash withdrawal without ATM limits
- [Credit Card Cash Advance](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/credit-card-cash-advance): Emergency credit and debit card cash advance services
- [Prepaid Visa Card](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/prepaid-visa-card): Prepaid Visa debit card activation and money transfer
- [Coin Into Cash/Coin Counting](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/coin-into-cash-coin-counting): Coin counting and conversion to cash service
- [Rolled Coin/Cash](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/rolled-coin-cash): Rolled coin exchange and business cash supply

## Vehicle & Transit Services

- [Auto Title & Registration](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/auto-title-registration): Illinois auto title, registration, and license plate renewal
- [License Plate Renewals](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/license-plate-renewals): DMV alternative for license plate renewal and registration
- [City Vehicle Stickers](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/city-vehicle-stickers): Chicago city vehicle sticker sales with instant service
- [Boat Title Registration, Transfer & Renewal](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/boat-title-registration-transfer-renewal): Boat title transfer, registration, and watercraft services
- [Ventra Cards](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/ventra-cards): Chicago CTA and Pace Buses Ventra transit card services

## Additional Services

- [Gift Card Redemption](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/gift-card-redemption): Gift card buyback and cash conversion service
- [Prepaid Phone Products](https://mycurrencyexchange.com/services/prepaid-phone-products): Prepaid phone cards and international calling services
